subject: general
question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Depresed"** is incorrectly spelt; the correct spelling should be "**Depressed**".
 
• **Depressed** means in a state of unhappiness or despondency. (उदासीन)
 
 
• **Example:** She has been feeling **depressed **ever since she lost her job.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Battle **(युद्ध): A sustained fight between large organized armed forces.

 
 
• **Example:** The **battle **lasted for several hours before the enemy retreated.
 
 
 
• **Comfortable **(आरामदायक): Providing physical ease and relaxation.
 
 
• **Example:** The chair is very **comfortable **to sit in.
 
 
 
• **Cheerful** (प्रसन्न): Noticeably happy and optimistic.
 
 
• **Example:** She always has a **cheerful **smile on her face.
